text.text: The odachi is the other great blade on the blade forge's recipe list, opposite in temper to the supreme great blade: this one hits harder.
Durability = material durability × 1.1; attack = material attack + 1.5. Compare the supreme great blade's 1.2 durability and +1.0 attack - one is light on its feet, the other hits like an anvil.
Colour, slash art and repair material still follow the material; an odachi blank is six iron ingots and a stick.
Pick Odachi in the recipe list and the forge only accepts odachi blanks; click the other entry to switch.
